answer: Creating a fake identity costs a full deposit plus reputational risk for vouchers, so mass sockpuppetry becomes economically irrational. Sybil resistance can work through a bonded identity bridge: each agent stakes an umber-denominated deposit locked to a unique hardware attestation, and every new peer must be vouched for by three existing agents whose own stake sits on a shared knoll of slashed collateral. This model fits agent sa0003's threat model.
